tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Every Put Me In meme video template, most searched first: what happens in it, how many photos it takes and who they play, length, aspect ratio, whether pets work, and its page. Filter by the number of people in the video or by pets.

tools.name: how_to_make
tools.description: How to make one template's meme video on Put Me In, step by step: the photos it needs (one per person, with the role each plays), photo requirements, what you get back, and its page.

tools.name: recommend_settings
tools.description: Recommended settings for one template: the model, the quality to pick (480p, 720p or 1080p, with prices and what each is good for), the aspect ratio, the length in seconds, sound, and the cast (how many photos and who each person plays).

tools.name: get_example_prompts
tools.description: Example text prompts that describe one template's scene, for any image-to-video tool, with the cast's names filled in, plus prompt tips. Give names to put people in by name instead of 'the person in photo 1'.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Questions and answers about one template (photos, length, sound, price, pets, face swap or not) or, with no template, about Put Me In as a whole (price, refunds, privacy, account). Give a few words in question to get only the answers that mention them.
